$comment: AGP's built-in NDK and CMake versions, used by libraries that pin neither (see androidSdk.mjs). Keyed on the AGP version in react-native's libs.versions.toml. Verified against a CI build log (2026-10-07, AGP 8.12.0): ':dr.pogodin_react-native-static-server' downloaded ndk;27.0.12077973 and react-native-nitro-modules' configureCMake downloaded cmake;3.22.1.

e2eEmulator.$comment: What the E2E flows job installs before reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner runs (keep in step with api-level/arch/target and the action's build-tools/platform list in e2e.yml). `cached` are the two big packages (emulator ~350 MB, system image ~1 GB): restored from actions/cache, on a miss fetched by a size+sha1 verified direct download, saved from main only. Bump `cacheSalt` to invalidate every cached copy.
